items.description: Recovery incl. locksmith call-out and cutting seized lock
items.rationale: Recovery costs under 5.2.2(a),(b) are covered but count toward the EUR 500 mobility aggregate sub-limit (4.2.2), shared rateably with the repair lines. Market recovery cost is about EUR 250, so the line is likely scaled down to roughly EUR 160.

Damage found on the recovered item is covered under 2.3.1(b) and 7.1.1(b). The repair likely exceeds the cap, so the EUR 500 aggregate sub-limit applies rateably and this line takes the largest share.
Labour and sundries serving the covered repair are payable under 7.1.7(d),(e). This line also falls within the EUR 500 aggregate sub-limit and is reduced rateably.
